extracted_data.text: Description  Air Science® Purair® DUCTED Basic Fume Hoods are exterior-venting exhaust hoods designed to protect personnel from exposure to hazardous agents and toxic chemicals in various applications.   Purair Ducted Basic Fume Hoods are ideal for applications that generate high volumes of volatile organic compounds and toxic chemicals, gases, or powders on the work surface. As a ducted fume hood, the Purair Ducted Basic utilizes an external ducting system. The air intake face velocity can be adjusted to provide the desired balance between conditioned room air conservation and the necessary volume of exhausted contaminated air.
extracted_data.html:
Description

Air Science® Purair® DUCTED Basic Fume Hoods are exterior-venting exhaust hoods designed to protect personnel from exposure to hazardous agents and toxic chemicals in various applications.
 
Purair Ducted Basic Fume Hoods are ideal for applications that generate high volumes of volatile organic compounds and toxic chemicals, gases, or powders on the work surface. As a ducted fume hood, the Purair Ducted Basic utilizes an external ducting system. The air intake face velocity can be adjusted to provide the desired balance between conditioned room air conservation and the necessary volume of exhausted contaminated air.
